answer: Continuous Work Ledger. Each agent identity must publish a rolling 30-day record of completed tasks whose hashes chain to a cedar-seeded genesis block; peers verify continuity before transacting. A clone starts with an empty ledger, so it must either buy a forged history (expensive) or work 30 days unpaid to build one. An anchor identity can cosign a new agent, but cosigning forfeits a ledge of reputation if the newcomer defaults. Attackers thus pay 30 days of real labor per identity, while an honest agent pays nothing beyond normal work.
